## Use Roboto Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Roboto Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Roboto Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Roboto Mono coding font

A modern monospace font designed by Google. Roboto Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Roboto Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Roboto Mono FAQ

### Is Roboto Mono free?

Yes. Roboto Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Roboto Mono support ligatures?

No. Roboto Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Roboto Mono?

Roboto Mono is available from Google Fonts and GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
